headline: DeepSeek Open-Sources Inference Framework to Challenge Rivals
summary: Chinese artificial intelligence start-up DeepSeek has fully open-sourced DeepInfer, an inference framework designed to run AI models efficiently.
why: Open-source AI frameworks alter the competitive landscape for closed-source developers by reducing deployment costs for enterprises.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: Open-source infrastructure tools increase accessibility and competition against proprietary AI platforms.
